appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'City Emissions Reduction by Program'.
Y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 70, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, ..., 70).
Bar for 'Building retrofits' is green and has a value of 41.2%.
Bar for 'Transit electrification' is blue and has a value of 29.8%.
Bar for 'Industrial efficiency' is purple and has a value of 18.5%.
Bar for 'Tree canopy' is dark green and has a value of 7.2%.
Bar for 'Methane capture' is brown and has a value of 3.3%.

printed_facts.fact: X-axis labels are: 'Building retrofits', 'Transit electrification', 'Industrial efficiency', 'Tree canopy', 'Methane capture'.
Bar heights correspond to: Building retrofits (41.2%), Transit electrification (29.8%), Industrial efficiency (18.5%), Tree canopy (7.2%), Methane capture (3.3%).

public_definitions: Use the dashboard to determine which city emissions-reduction program is the largest contribution category for this routing decision.

Program routing decision: Route Building retrofits to accelerated program review, Route Transit electrification to accelerated program review, Keep Industrial efficiency in routine program monitoring.
Routing basis: Largest city emissions-reduction contribution program.
